name: Just One
summary: Cooperative party word game where all but one player give unique one-word clues to help guess a mystery word.
rules_text: Shuffle word cards and make a face-down deck of 13. Each player gets an easel. Each turn one player is the active guesser. They draw a card unseen and place it on their easel so others see 5 words, then call a number 1-5 to choose the mystery word. Other players secretly write one valid single-word clue each. Invalid clues are those that are the mystery word misspelled, translated, same family, invented, or homophone, and also any digit or symbol counts as a word. After writing, the guesser closes their eyes while others reveal clues; any identical clues (identical, plural, gender variant, family variant, or spelling variant) and any invalid clues are cancelled by tipping those easels. Guesser opens eyes, sees remaining clues, and gets one guess or may pass. On correct guess keep the card as point, on wrong guess discard it and burn the top of deck, on pass discard it. Next player becomes guesser. Ends when deck empty; score is number of kept cards.
rating_reason: Clue writing guessing game, hidden info, text-only playable
